fields.why: The text ranks hospitalization increases across the three age groups ('largest increase ... among children aged ≤5 years'), which compares time trends across 3 SPD groups (rule 4). The weakest of the five: no per-group data are shown.
The age groups are ≤5, 6–12 and 13–19 years; the only other SPD, sex, appears just as Table composition.
The mechanical flag is a false alarm: the linear-trend p-value (Figure 1 note) is for the overall annual rate, not a test across age groups.

brief_issues: Borderline between rule 4 (trends compared across SPD groups) and rule 6 (composition): a ranking of group increases stated in the text without per-group data. The brief could say whether an unshown ranking of increases counts.
